I’m Aman. I write about AI agents, large language models, and building reliable, scalable agentic systems that actually work in production.

I currently work at AWS. Previously, I was a Lead AI Engineer at Relevance AI and a Data Science Lead at REA Group, where I worked on property valuation models covering 12.2 million Australian homes.

I’m interested in both ends of the problem: understanding how models work from first principles, and turning that understanding into systems that are reliable, observable, and built to last. This blog is where I work through those ideas in public—usually by building something, looking under the hood, and sharing what I learn.

I write here in a personal capacity. The views expressed are my own and do not represent my employer.
